auth_config_env: auth.providers (site config; no default — must be explicitly set)
auth.public (site config; default false — anonymous browse toggle)
default_creds: first-admin-wins on fresh install — admin account created by whoever reaches port 7080 first after docker run
Grafana sidecar (port 3000) — admin/admin pre-bootstrap on legacy stacks
install_tell: docker run --publish 7080:7080 --publish 127.0.0.1:3370:3370 --rm --volume ~/.sourcegraph/config:/etc/sourcegraph --volume ~/.sourcegraph/data:/var/opt/sourcegraph sourcegraph/server:<ver> (single-container REMOVED in 7.0.0; Helm + docker-compose are current)
misconfig_patterns: auth.public: true — anonymous repository / user / search read
first-admin race window between docker run and admin creation
authz.enforceForSiteAdmins: false — admin tokens bypass per-repo permission checks
Prometheus sidecar (:9090) exposed host-side — /api/v1/targets leaks entire Sourcegraph service inventory (Insight #11)
Direct IP exposure of internal services (pgsql 5432, redis 6379, zoekt 6070, gitserver 3178, blobstore 9000) when --network host or bad firewall (Insight #12)
gitserver (port 3178) reachable from internet — CVE-2022-23642 surface still relevant on stale installs
Schema introspection enabled by default on /.api/graphql — surface-area leak even when resolvers are auth-gated
Cody endpoints reachable without access token on misconfigured installs — LLM-billing-theft + indexed-content disclosure (2023-08 incident class)

response_markers: data.site.productVersion present as semver string (e.g. 6.x or 7.x)
errors[].message references 'site' resolver when unauth gated
active_probe.false_positive_check: X-Trace header alone is not unique; pair with productVersion semver pattern AND title 'Sourcegraph' AND /.api/graphql 200 path. Cody-only fingerprints must additionally match /.api/cody/context or /.api/completions/stream OPTIONS reflection (do NOT POST).

deployment_tells: Caddy reverse proxy in front (compose default; Server: Caddy header)
X-Trace response header on /.api/graphql (Jaeger trace id, always set)
X-Trace-Url response header when X-Sourcegraph-Should-Trace: true request header sent
Webpack bundle path /.assets/scripts/ with hashed filenames
License-key-tied OV certs on Caddy with *.sourcegraph.* CN patterns
pivot_paths: GET / → SPA shell + productVersion in webpack manifest → CVE scoping
POST /.api/graphql introspection query → resolver surface area without exercising any resolver
POST /.api/graphql {repositories(first:5){nodes{name}}} → only succeeds if auth.public:true → repo-name disclosure (private IP)
Prometheus :9090 /api/v1/targets (Insight #11) → full Sourcegraph service inventory + internal hostnames
Direct IP scan for 5432/6379/6070/3178/9000 on same host (Insight #12) → DB / cache / index / git / blob shadow surface
gitserver :3178 + CVE-2022-23642 core.sshCommand on stale (<3.37) installs → RCE
Leaked site-admin access token → LLM-billing-theft via Cody endpoints (2023-08 incident class) — DISCLOSE, do not exercise
vulnerabilities: CVE-2022-23642 (gitserver RCE pre-3.37, High): core.sshCommand git-config injection via HTTP args; public PoC (Altelus1) + ExploitDB 50964; only exploitable if gitserver exposed
Pre-3.41 saved-search overwrite (Medium): authz check bug; write-only, no read
Cody VSCode extension <0.14.1 (Critical, low exploitability): malicious repo + /explain or /doc → arbitrary code exec on client host — CLIENT not server
2023-08 sourcegraph.com admin-token leak (incident, not CVE): leaked site-admin token from PR weaponized to mint admin account + LLM-proxy abuse; license-key + PII exposure for paid users
